name: init
title_zh: 为代码库生成高信号 AGENTS.md 的初始化工具
tagline_zh: 新仓库要配 AI 助手？它自动扫描代码，提炼非显性约定与怪癖，生成精简 AGENTS.md，避免冗长泛泛而谈。
tagline_en: Setting up AI for a new repo? It scans code, extracts hidden conventions and quirks, and writes a lean.
desc_en: Creates, updates, or optimizes an AGENTS.md file for a repository with minimal, high-signal instructions covering non-discoverable coding conventions, tooling quirks, workflow preferences, and project-specific rules that agents cannot infer from reading the codebase. Use when setting up agent instructions or Claude configuration for a new repository, when an existing AGENTS.md is too long, generic
why_zh: 机制上它聚焦“代码里读不出来”的信息，通过分析仓库结构生成最小必要指令，而非堆砌通用规则。
why_en: Unlike generic templates, it mines the repo for non-obvious details, producing only what an agent can't infer—so setup is fast.
limit_zh: 只针对 AGENTS.md 的创建与优化，不处理其他配置文件；需仓库已有可扫描的代码结构，空仓库或纯文档项目可能产出有。
limit_en: Only handles AGENTS.md creation/optimization; requires a codebase to scan; empty or doc-only repos yield limited output; manual review still needed.
